## W11 - Error alert (Telegram)
Any workflow that fails -> this one -> a Telegram message in your "agency-alerts" group.
The message holds only the workflow name, step, a trimmed error text and a link. No patient data.
The same failure alerts at most once per 10 minutes (so a Grist outage doesn't flood your phone).

**Set up once:**
1. Telegram: make a bot with @BotFather, make a group "agency-alerts", add the bot to it.
2. n8n > Credentials > Create > **Telegram API**, paste the bot token, save as "Telegram agency-alerts bot". Pick it in the *Telegram alert* node.
3. Edit the **Config** node: telegram_chat_id = the group's chat id (a negative number like -100123...).
4. Open each workflow you want covered (start with W1) > ... menu > **Settings** > *Error workflow* > choose this workflow > Save.

Does not need to be activated.
